Bubba's Mattress & Furniture is an authorized Ashley Furniture dealer on Terry Rd in Louisville. We carry the full Ashley catalog — not just what fits in a showroom. Sectionals, sofas, recliners, bedroom sets, mattresses, dining room sets, outdoor furniture, home office, kids rooms, all of it.

Same Furniture, Different Experience

The Ashley corporate stores in Louisville are on Jefferson Blvd and Bluegrass Pkwy. They carry the same products we do. The difference is how you're treated when you walk in and what happens when you need to pay for it.

At the big store, you get a salesperson working commission. At Bubba's, you get Colton — the owner — who actually answers his phone and remembers your name.

Financing That Works for Louisville

The big Ashley stores offer Synchrony financing, which requires good credit. We offer that too — plus three no-credit-check options that the corporate stores don't have:

  • Progressive Leasing — $49 down, 90 days no interest, no credit check
  • Acima — $25 down, 90 days no interest, no credit check
  • Koalifi — $50 down, 100 days no interest, builds your credit with TransUnion

Most of our customers get approved in under 5 minutes. See all financing options and apply here.

What We Carry

Everything Ashley makes. If it's on ashleyfurniture.com, we can get it. Some of our most popular Ashley pieces in Louisville right now:

  • Sectionals — Midnight Madness, Lindyn, Rawcliffe, Barrelton, and more
  • Recliners — power, manual, and lift recliners
  • Bedroom Sets — queen and king sets with dressers, nightstands, mirrors
  • Mattresses — Ashley Sleep, Sierra Sleep, memory foam, hybrid, innerspring
  • Dining Room — 5-piece, 7-piece, counter height sets

Delivery

We deliver within 50 miles of Louisville. Most items arrive in 1-2 weeks from the Ashley warehouse. You get a call when it ships and another when it's ready to schedule delivery.
